cond_0001.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
This position is responsible for performing a variety of quality assurance audits on incoming products in-process production as well as finished products to ensure that they meet regulatory and company standards of quality. This position also assists in planning and establishing additional FSQ activities and procedures
Monitors daily adherence to Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs) and reports issues to management
Generates reports such as specification notices and trend analysis using Microsoft Windows, Word, and Excel; also processes transactions in SAP to release product from QA hold
Verifies regulatory formula and procedural compliance of manufacturing systems and takes corrective action when necessary
Documents review and verification to ensure compliance to company and regulatory requirements
Must be able to work with Food Chemistry Microbiology Sensory and Product Development to gather samples and information needed for product testing
Evaluates Certificate of Analysis data against specification and takes appropriate action when necessary
Works with production management to rework product for most routine product quality issues
Generates and maintains reports of all testing performed and all quality and food safety issues
Conducts plant food safety/GMP orientation when necessary
Performs associated formulation audits and quality checks as necessary and according to product specifications
Complete the investigation and the documenting of incidents involving product/ingredient Food Safety issues
The use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) is required; including but not limited to bump cap, safety glasses/goggles, ear plugs, hair and beard nets, gloves and safety shoes or rubber boots
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Read and interpret basic technical documents
Demonstrate knowledge of HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) as it applies to specific plant operations
Confirm a satisfactory current job performance and safety record
Work in a variety of temperatures
Learn and operate standard laboratory equipment and keep accurate documentation of daily information
Communicate in English (verbally and through writing) to accurately create and document company reports
Ability to read and understand product specifications and perform basic math functions
Candidates receiving offers of employment will be required to complete a post-offer, pre-placement background check and drug screen
Preferred Requirements
High school diploma or equivalent
HACCP certification
Solid interpersonal and communication skills and intermediate level proficiency in SAP, the Microsoft Office Suite to include Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

cond_0012.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
cond_0012.responsibilities:
This position is responsible for performing a variety of quality assurance audits on incoming products in-process production as well as finished products to ensure that they meet regulatory and company standards of quality. This position also assists in planning and establishing additional FSQ activities and procedures
Monitors daily adherence to Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs) and reports issues to management
Generates reports such as specification notices and trend analysis using Microsoft Windows, Word, and Excel; also processes transactions in SAP to release product from QA hold
Verifies regulatory formula and procedural compliance of manufacturing systems and takes corrective action when necessary
Documents review and verification to ensure compliance to company and regulatory requirements
Must be able to work with Food Chemistry Microbiology Sensory and Product Development to gather samples and information needed for product testing
Evaluates Certificate of Analysis data against specification and takes appropriate action when necessary
Works with production management to rework product for most routine product quality issues
Generates and maintains reports of all testing performed and all quality and food safety issues
Conducts plant food safety/GMP orientation when necessary
Performs associated formulation audits and quality checks as necessary and according to product specifications
Complete the investigation and the documenting of incidents involving product/ingredient Food Safety issues
The use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) is required; including but not limited to bump cap, safety glasses/goggles, ear plugs, hair and beard nets, gloves and safety shoes or rubber boots
cond_0012.requirements:
A high school diploma or equivalent is preferred, or equivalent practical experience
Ability to read and interpret basic technical documents
Some background in HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) as it applies to plant operations; HACCP certification is preferred, or willingness to obtain
Satisfactory current job performance and safety record
Comfort working in a variety of temperatures
Willingness to learn and operate standard laboratory equipment and keep accurate documentation of daily information
Ability to communicate in English (verbally and in writing) to create and document company reports
Ability to read and understand product specifications and perform basic math functions
Familiarity with interpersonal and communication skills, and working knowledge of SAP and the Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
Candidates receiving offers of employment will be required to complete a post-offer, pre-placement background check and drug screen

cond_0077.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team in this role. People usually grow into this kind of quality assurance work over time as they build experience with food safety processes and plant operations.
cond_0077.responsibilities:
This position is responsible for performing a variety of quality assurance audits on incoming products in-process production as well as finished products to ensure that they meet regulatory and company standards of quality. This position also assists in planning and establishing additional FSQ activities and procedures
Monitors daily adherence to Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs) and reports issues to management
Generates reports such as specification notices and trend analysis using Microsoft Windows, Word, and Excel; also processes transactions in SAP to release product from QA hold
Verifies regulatory formula and procedural compliance of manufacturing systems and takes corrective action when necessary
Documents review and verification to ensure compliance to company and regulatory requirements
Must be able to work with Food Chemistry Microbiology Sensory and Product Development to gather samples and information needed for product testing
Evaluates Certificate of Analysis data against specification and takes appropriate action when necessary
Works with production management to rework product for most routine product quality issues
Generates and maintains reports of all testing performed and all quality and food safety issues
Conducts plant food safety/GMP orientation when necessary
Performs associated formulation audits and quality checks as necessary and according to product specifications
Complete the investigation and the documenting of incidents involving product/ingredient Food Safety issues
The use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) is required; including but not limited to bump cap, safety glasses/goggles, ear plugs, hair and beard nets, gloves and safety shoes or rubber boots
cond_0077.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Read and interpret basic technical documents
Demonstrate knowledge of HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) as it applies to specific plant operations
Confirm a satisfactory current job performance and safety record
Work in a variety of temperatures
Learn and operate standard laboratory equipment and keep accurate documentation of daily information
Communicate in English (verbally and through writing) to accurately create and document company reports
Ability to read and understand product specifications and perform basic math functions
Candidates receiving offers of employment will be required to complete a post-offer, pre-placement background check and drug screen
Preferred Requirements
High school diploma or equivalent
HACCP certification
Demonstrate solid interpersonal and communication skills and intermediate level proficiency in SAP, the Microsoft Office Suite to include Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

This position is responsible for performing a variety of quality assurance audits on incoming products in-process production as well as finished products to ensure that they meet regulatory and company standards of quality. This position also assists in planning and establishing additional FSQ activities and procedures
Monitors daily adherence to Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs) and reports issues to management
Generates reports such as specification notices and trend analysis using Microsoft Windows, Word, and Excel; also processes transactions in SAP to release product from QA hold
Verifies regulatory formula and procedural compliance of manufacturing systems and takes corrective action when necessary
Documents review and verification to ensure compliance to company and regulatory requirements
Must be able to work with Food Chemistry Microbiology Sensory and Product Development to gather samples and information needed for product testing
Evaluates Certificate of Analysis data against specification and takes appropriate action when necessary
Works with production management to rework product for most routine product quality issues
Generates and maintains reports of all testing performed and all quality and food safety issues
Conducts plant food safety/GMP orientation when necessary
Performs associated formulation audits and quality checks as necessary and according to product specifications
Complete the investigation and the documenting of incidents involving product/ingredient Food Safety issues
The use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) is required; including but not limited to bump cap, safety glasses/goggles, ear plugs, hair and beard nets, gloves and safety shoes or rubber boots
cond_0101.requirements:
High school diploma or equivalent required; additional relevant education or certification strongly preferred
Demonstrated ability to read and interpret basic technical documents
Advanced knowledge of HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) as it applies to specific plant operations; HACCP certification strongly preferred
Proven track record of satisfactory job performance and a strong safety record
Ability to work in a variety of temperatures
Demonstrated expertise in operating standard laboratory equipment and maintaining accurate documentation of daily information
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to accurately create and document company reports
Strong command of product specifications and solid proficiency in basic math functions
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills and strong proficiency in SAP and the Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
Candidates receiving offers of employment will be required to complete a post-offer, pre-placement background check and drug screen
cond_0101.values: We value contributing in ways that are helpful, responsible, and considerate of others. We believe the quality of our work includes how well it serves people and how fairly it is carried out.
cond_0101.workplace_support: We foster connection and community through employee groups and inclusive workplace initiatives so people can bring their full selves to work and find support across different identities and life experiences.

This position is responsible for performing a variety of quality assurance audits on incoming products in-process production as well as finished products to ensure that they meet regulatory and company standards of quality. This position also assists in planning and establishing additional FSQ activities and procedures
Monitors daily adherence to Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs) and reports issues to management
Generates reports such as specification notices and trend analysis using Microsoft Windows, Word, and Excel; also processes transactions in SAP to release product from QA hold
Verifies regulatory formula and procedural compliance of manufacturing systems and takes corrective action when necessary
Documents review and verification to ensure compliance to company and regulatory requirements
Must be able to work with Food Chemistry Microbiology Sensory and Product Development to gather samples and information needed for product testing
Evaluates Certificate of Analysis data against specification and takes appropriate action when necessary
Works with production management to rework product for most routine product quality issues
Generates and maintains reports of all testing performed and all quality and food safety issues
Conducts plant food safety/GMP orientation when necessary
Performs associated formulation audits and quality checks as necessary and according to product specifications
Complete the investigation and the documenting of incidents involving product/ingredient Food Safety issues
The use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) is required; including but not limited to bump cap, safety glasses/goggles, ear plugs, hair and beard nets, gloves and safety shoes or rubber boots
cond_0275.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Read and interpret basic technical documents
Demonstrate knowledge of HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) as it applies to specific plant operations
Confirm a satisfactory current job performance and safety record
Work in a variety of temperatures
Learn and operate standard laboratory equipment and keep accurate documentation of daily information
Communicate in English (verbally and through writing) to accurately create and document company reports
Ability to read and understand product specifications and perform basic math functions
Candidates receiving offers of employment will be required to complete a post-offer, pre-placement background check and drug screen
Preferred Requirements
High school diploma or equivalent
HACCP certification
Demonstrate solid interpersonal and communication skills and intermediate level proficiency in SAP, the Microsoft Office Suite to include Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

cond_0298.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
cond_0298.responsibilities:
This position is responsible for performing a variety of quality assurance audits on incoming products in-process production as well as finished products to ensure that they meet regulatory and company standards of quality. This position also assists in planning and establishing additional FSQ activities and procedures
Monitors daily adherence to Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs) and reports issues to management
Generates reports such as specification notices and trend analysis using Microsoft Windows, Word, and Excel; also processes transactions in SAP to release product from QA hold
Verifies regulatory formula and procedural compliance of manufacturing systems and takes corrective action when necessary
Documents review and verification to ensure compliance to company and regulatory requirements
Must be able to work with Food Chemistry Microbiology Sensory and Product Development to gather samples and information needed for product testing
Evaluates Certificate of Analysis data against specification and takes appropriate action when necessary
Works with production management to rework product for most routine product quality issues
Generates and maintains reports of all testing performed and all quality and food safety issues
Conducts plant food safety/GMP orientation when necessary
Performs associated formulation audits and quality checks as necessary and according to product specifications
Complete the investigation and the documenting of incidents involving product/ingredient Food Safety issues
The use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) is required; including but not limited to bump cap, safety glasses/goggles, ear plugs, hair and beard nets, gloves and safety shoes or rubber boots

This position also assists in planning and establishing additional FSQ activities and procedures
Monitors daily adherence to Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs) and reports issues to management
Generates reports such as specification notices and trend analysis using Microsoft Windows, Word, and Excel; also processes transactions in SAP to release product from QA hold
Verifies regulatory formula and procedural compliance of manufacturing systems and takes corrective action when necessary
Documents review and verification to ensure compliance to company and regulatory requirements
Must be able to work with Food Chemistry Microbiology Sensory and Product Development to gather samples and information needed for product testing
Evaluates Certificate of Analysis data against specification and takes appropriate action when necessary
Works with production management to rework product for most routine product quality issues
Generates and maintains reports of all testing performed and all quality and food safety issues
Conducts plant food safety/GMP orientation when necessary
Performs associated formulation audits and quality checks as necessary and according to product specifications
Complete the investigation and the documenting of incidents involving product/ingredient Food Safety issues
The use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) is required; including but not limited to bump cap, safety glasses/goggles, ear plugs, hair and beard nets, gloves and safety shoes or rubber boots

Read and interpret basic technical documents
Demonstrate knowledge of HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) as it applies to specific plant operations (HACCP certification preferred)

Work in a variety of temperatures
Learn and operate standard laboratory equipment and keep accurate documentation of daily information

This position is responsible for performing a variety of quality assurance audits on incoming products in-process production as well as finished products to ensure that they meet regulatory and company standards of quality. This position also assists in planning and establishing additional FSQ activities and procedures
Monitors daily adherence to Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs) and reports issues to management
Generates reports such as specification notices and trend analysis using Microsoft Windows, Word, and Excel; also processes transactions in SAP to release product from QA hold
Verifies regulatory formula and procedural compliance of manufacturing systems and takes corrective action when necessary
Documents review and verification to ensure compliance to company and regulatory requirements
Must be able to work with Food Chemistry Microbiology Sensory and Product Development to gather samples and information needed for product testing
Evaluates Certificate of Analysis data against specification and takes appropriate action when necessary
Works with production management to rework product for most routine product quality issues
Generates and maintains reports of all testing performed and all quality and food safety issues
Conducts plant food safety/GMP orientation when necessary
Performs associated formulation audits and quality checks as necessary and according to product specifications
Complete the investigation and the documenting of incidents involving product/ingredient Food Safety issues
The use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) is required; including but not limited to bump cap, safety glasses/goggles, ear plugs, hair and beard nets, gloves and safety shoes or rubber boots
cond_0551.requirements:
High school diploma or equivalent required; additional relevant education or certification strongly preferred
Demonstrated ability to read and interpret basic technical documents
Advanced knowledge of HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) as it applies to specific plant operations; HACCP certification strongly preferred
Proven track record of satisfactory job performance and a strong safety record
Ability to work in a variety of temperatures
Demonstrated expertise in operating standard laboratory equipment and maintaining accurate documentation of daily information
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to accurately create and document company reports
Strong command of product specifications and solid proficiency in basic math functions
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills and strong proficiency in SAP and the Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
Candidates receiving offers of employment will be required to complete a post-offer, pre-placement background check and drug screen
cond_0551.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0551.inclusion: [Company name masked] is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build.
